task: Select the best zero, one, or two useful secondary emotions expressed by the raw human-written text.

outputSemantics.zero: Use no label when the text is neutral, purely factual, too ambiguous, or has no sufficiently evidenced taxonomy emotion.
outputSemantics.secondary: A label must add a distinct, useful emotional characterization. Do not output synonyms or two labels for the same affective signal.
outputSemantics.speakerRule: Label the writer's own emotion, not merely an emotion attributed to another person.
outputSemantics.evidenceRule: Implicit emotion is allowed only when strongly supported by the event and wording; do not invent unstated feelings.

definitions.admiration: respectful approval or being impressed by someone or something
definitions.amusement: finding something funny, playful, or entertaining
definitions.annoyance: milder irritation, frustration, or being bothered
definitions.caring: concern for, nurturing of, or desire to support another
definitions.confusion: uncertainty about understanding, interpretation, or what to do
definitions.curiosity: interest or desire to know, learn, or investigate
definitions.disappointment: sadness or dissatisfaction because hopes or expectations were unmet
definitions.disgust: revulsion, strong aversion, or moral/physical repugnance
definitions.fear: anxiety, worry, threat, dread, or feeling unsafe
definitions.gratitude: thankfulness or appreciation for a benefit or kindness received
definitions.joy: happiness, delight, contentment, or positive pleasure
definitions.love: deep affection, attachment, or warmth toward someone
definitions.optimism: hopeful expectation or confidence about a favorable future
definitions.remorse: guilt, regret, or sorrow over one's own action or failure
definitions.surprise: being startled or encountering something notably unexpected

forbiddenInputs: information designed to improve candidate scores

agreement: Exact set equality after validating allowed labels, uniqueness, and cardinality 0-2.

adjudication.trigger: Pass A and Pass B label sets are not exactly equal, or either pass is invalid after one format-only retry.
adjudication.rule: Choose the best final 0-2 set from the text. The final set need not equal either pass, but may not use information outside allowed inputs.
adjudication.invalidAfterRetry: Exclude row for annotation failure before any candidate inference; never infer a reference label locally.

locking.candidateInferenceGate: No candidate may read the evaluation texts until cohort manifest, pass outputs, adjudications, final labels, exclusions, hashes, and leakage audit are complete and marked LOCKED.
locking.postInferenceRelabeling: Forbidden. Prediction errors can never trigger Gemini re-annotation or label changes.
locking.metric: Macro-F1 over all 18 labels with zero_division=0; Micro-F1 may be supplementary only.
